title: Spider across its web

source.why_this_clip: The spider turns and steps across its web; the camera drifts; continuous.
source.why_this_interval: Sixteen source samples show one continuous turn and reach on the web. Camera rises while the spider descends relative to its background. No cut visible in retained samples; normal-speed review unrun.

camera.method: cumulative robust background LK flow; excludes spider region; image pixels at 320x240

assembly_summary: The original nine-stroke spider changes body attitude and eight leg reaches over one held macro background and web. Source body and endpoint keys are manually observed; background-only optical flow supplies camera movement. The partly hidden eighth reach is constrained rather than tracked.
review_note: Independent review passed all eight sampled source poses and the original doodle identity. Filled drawing/SAM fit fails (mean 0.2535; minimum 0.1754). No verified planted intervals; classifier and actual normal-speed playback approval remain unrun. No training ran.

mask_fit.method: filled native body +2px legs vs nearest SAM12fps sample, approximate time pairing
mask_fit.limitations: Four overlay samples visually capture body and most visible legs; thin distal parts are partial, and some web streaks join the mask. Model IoU estimate is not measured drawing fit.
